plugins.description: Steam's Big Picture speaks through TurnOver: the item you are on, as you move with the arrows or a controller. Games started with a debugging port (Electron games) speak their announcements too. Turn it off or on in the TurnOver menu, Preferences, Games.

plugins.summary: Steam's Big Picture and Electron games speak through TurnOver.
